description:
Three large Tiffany & Co. Florentine serving pieces an elaborate, classical appearance. Their ornate handles feature layered borders and pointed decorative tips, complemented by a pierced serving surface, a shell-shaped spoon bowl, and a triangular server with a serrated edge.
The three Tiffany pieces include a cake or pie server, a broad pierced server, and a shell-shaped serving spoon. The photographed Tiffany marking reads “Tiffany & Co.,” “Sterling,” and “Pat. 1900.” Florentine was introduced in 1900; the patent marking refers to the pattern rather than establishing these pieces’ manufacture date.
Also included are three assorted sterling silver spoons in differing designs, including one with a sharply curved handle. These smaller pieces are not Tiffany.

shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight via Fedex Ground or Home Delivery. We do not use Express or overnight shipping. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight. These are Fedex rules, not ours. We try to ship items the day after receiving payment. Payments must be received by 7:00 am to be shipped that day. After 7:00 am the item(s) will ship the following day. We generally do not work weekends and therefore shipping is not done on those days.
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
We put ADULT SIGNATURE REQUIRED on your package delivery if your order totals more than $100.00 excluding, tax, handling and shipping. Items under the value of $100.00 will NOT be receiving the signature option. This is to help prevent porch theft and to minimize lost packages. We are doing this for you, the buyer. This requirement is in your best interest and at no cost to you. We are paying for this surcharge and it is our way of giving back to you to ensure you receive your item(s).
If you would prefer not to have the signature requirement, please contact us by opening a service ticket to let us know that you would not prefer it
. If you place your item on hold for pickup at any Fedex location that has Adult Signature Required, you will be required to show ID but your address on the ID must match the ship to address on the label.
Regarding lost or delayed packages: If a package has been or is being delayed (non-movement on the tracking number after 2-4 days), please notify us by opening a customer service ticket for your shipped item. We will, in turn, file a claim on our behalf with Fedex for your package. This will trigger a search for your package, if found by Fedex, your package will start moving again. If not found, Fedex will pay the claim. When Fedex marks the claim as paid in their system, we will then issue your refund, not before, no exceptions. This process can take 2-4 weeks to resolve. We check on claim statuses Monday - Friday and will issue your refund accordingly.
REMINDER:
If you place your item on hold for pickup at a Fedex location, you have 7 days (including weekends) to pick up your package. Failure to pick up your package at the hold location results in the package being returned to us. You will then have to pay new shipping charges if you want your item re-shipped. If not, the item is then considered a donation and there will be no refunds issued under any circumstances.
Fedex does not deliver to PO Boxes
. You must provide a physical street address. If you have a PO Box setup on your account that you use, you may modify your SHIP TO ADDRESS when submitting your payment.
WE DO NOT CANCEL ORDERS DUE TO SHIPPING COSTS
. We strongly urge users to estimate shipping before bidding. We do not lower or alter FedEx rates and will not cancel orders for shipping cost reasons.

description:
Decatur Industries
Walnut Pipe Stand Carousel with Green Glass Humidor & 8 Estate Pipes
Walnut Wood, Textured Glass, Mixed Materials
Vintage smoking pipe carousel stand manufactured by Decatur Industries, featuring an 8-slot solid walnut rack paired with a textured green glass tobacco humidor jar and a wooden lid topped with an Oscar the Grouch figural finial. The lot includes eight collectible estate smoking pipes representing classic briar, metal frame, and mid-century synthetic styles.
Decatur Industries rotating walnut carousel with 8 pipe storage slots
Center textured green glass humidor jar with embossed maker mark on base and Oscar the Grouch lid handle
Lot of 8 vintage pipes including "The Smoke" marbled graphite pipe, a blue pipe, a gold-tone radiator pipe, and 5 carved briar pipes
Measures approximately 9.75 by 9.75 inches and 8.5 inches high
Condition:
Wood carousel and green glass jar are well preserved with light surface wear and no chips or cracks. Pipes are in pre-owned estate condition displaying smoke charring, bowl cake, and light stem tooth marks consistent with age and use.
Bidding:
By bidding on items, bidders understand and accept all of the following:
All merchandise is sold in
AS IS
condition. Items are represented to the best of our ability,
ARE
previously used  and may contain unseen/hidden flaws which we are unable to ascertain and for which we do not accept responsibility for. No refunds will be issued in part or in whole for any unseen for undetectable flaws that would require disassembly of the item or for replaced parts that may not be original to the item as a whole. We do not disassemble merchandise prior to auction or upon request. Bidders are responsible for reading the full content of the listing prior to placing your bid and familiarizing yourself with our policies as listed below. We do not provide photos or answer questions regarding items after the auction has ended. Bidders/buyers are responsible for obtaining your shipping cost estimate prior to placing your bid.
BUY IT NOW: BUY IT NOW orders must be completed and checked out in one sitting.
You cannot "add a BUY IT NOW item to your cart," "hold," "win," or "claim" BUY IT NOW items in any way other than
completing payment
! If you leave the order screen during checkout on a BIN item, site and order errors can occur! Contact us via a Customer Service Ticket for information regarding BIN item shipping combinations.
DISCLAIMER:
This is a used, donated item that has not been cleaned, serviced or tested for functionality unless otherwise noted in the listing. Items that are not intended for collectible use should be inspected and/or serviced by a professional prior to use. We review materials used, maker’s marks, and quality of manufacture to ensure that our listings for items are accurate. Unless otherwise stated in the listing, items do not come with official certificates and will not include documentation. You are bidding with this in mind. Unless the word Authentic, Authenticated or with COA appears in the title, then the item HAS NOT BEEN authenticated by a third party. You bid with that information in mind and there will be no returns accepted for any reason.
Any listing of a "Grabbag" or containing the word "Grabbag" should be considered FINAL SALE, NO RETURNS WILL  BE GRANTED ON GRABBAG ITEMS.
IMPORTANT NOTES:
Once an order is paid for, there will be no refunds on combined shipping if you did not ask for it prior to paying for your order. We will not retract bids from an item once an auction ends. Bids can only be removed from open/active auctions at our discretion. There is no guarantee that we will approve your retraction request. We do not offer extensions past the payment due date of an item. Items are automatically relisted once the payment deadline expires. Requests for extensions will be denied. We do not cancel orders. WILL NOT CANCEL ORDERS DUE TO SHIPPING COSTS.
Failure to pay for your item results in a non-pay strike automatically being logged against your account. It is NOT our policy to remove non-pay strikes from your account. To avoid non-pay strikes on your account, pay for your item in a timely fashion.
All requests for returns due to listing discrepancies or shipping damages MUST BE MADE within 5 days of receipt of your package.
PHOTOGRAPHS:
All photographs are considered to be part of the description of the item, please be sure to review them before placing your bid. We DO NOT color enhance our photos. All photos are taken with iPhones and under LED lighting. Due to the way individuals see colors, the differences in color computer monitors and cameras there may be slight variations and or differences between the actual item and the photographs. There are no returns accepted on any item for color variation.
TESTING:
All of our jewelry offerings are tested prior to going to auction. We use a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Metal Analyzer to test for precious metals and or JSP Acid Solution Testing in conjunction with the aforementioned analyzer.
We describe each item to the best of our ability; however, we are
NOT
experts in any field. All gemstones are measured using electronic calipers.
All gemstones are tested on a Presidium Gemstone Tester. This equipment CANNOT determine between natural, lab created and synthetic gemstones. There are no returns accepted for lab created or synthetic gemstones.
Items may be vintage, antique or newer. There is still a chance that the stones can become loose or that a connector may need to be tightened. We are as delicate as possible with the items, but there is a possibility we may miss the flaw or that it may happen during shipment. No refunds permitted or given for gemstones that become dislodged from their setting in or during shipment.
TERMINOLOGY USED IN OUR LISTINGS:
The definition of the word
stone(s)
can be anything at all. It is only being used as more of a descriptive word/placeholder. These can be anything from genuine gemstone, lab created, synthetic, glass, plastic or crystal "stones". Unless specifically stated as gemstone(s) there will be no returns accepted for jewelry where the word "stone(s)" is used in our listing. Please make sure you understand and take that into account before placing a bid.
Pearls are tested to the best of our ability for texture and layering. They are not professionally tested. Pearls that do not pass the texture and layering test are labeled "faux". The approximate diameter is provided for size only, and the pearl(s) may or may not be perfectly round. 90% of the world's pearls are now cultured and are not naturally occurring. We cannot distinguish between cultured and natural pearls. You are bidding with this knowledge in mind.
Color, when we describe the color (of a stone, gem, bead, or anything that is described by a color), we may have different lighting than you & some of us see colors differently. Please know that the color that is described could be slightly different & a return will not be accepted for this reason.
Amber is determined to be an organic by-product (ie not plastic) and we cannot make any statement as to age or if it has fossilized.
Bakelite has been identified via the scrubbing bubbles test or metal polish.

Description
: Explore the fascinating world of minerals with this vintage rock collection in a sturdy white display box. This set contains 29 numbered mineral and igneous rock samples, each neatly organized and labeled. Included is a detailed typewritten identification sheet that provides names and characteristics for several specimens, aiding learning and display. The solid, hinged box has a carrying handle, making it easy to transport and store safely. Ideal for students, beginners, or collectors, these varied specimens offer hands-on educational value and visual appeal. The rocks are secured in a fitted case, which shows some age and wear but remains fully functional. Whether as a teaching aid or a collectible display, this set offers both value and versatility for earth science enthusiasts. Visible condition: Rocks are intact, case shows some surface marks

Description:
This bundle presents a diverse collection of crystal and mineral rocks, ideal for collectors, learners, or as decorative accents. The set includes various natural specimens, such as polished geode halves displaying distinct striated patterns, crystalline clusters with glimmering surfaces, and notable mineral samples. Two labeled display cards are included, featuring mounted specimens: one card lists anthracite coal, banded sandstone, copper ore, granite, and marble; the other card displays amethyst, carnelian, jade (missing piece), milky quartz, and tiger eye. Each stone is unique in coloration, texture, and shape, providing both visual appeal and educational value. The assortment will enhance any decor, spark curiosity in geology, or serve as a tactile teaching aid. The items are in used condition with minor handling wear and the jade piece is missing from the display card. Overall, this bundle showcases visually striking and varied stones, suitable for display, collecting, or gifting to crystal enthusiasts. Category: Collectibles & Art

Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

description:
Natural Amethyst Quartz Crystal Cluster Lot
Rough Mineral Specimens, 4 Pieces
Natural Geode and Druzy Formations, Brazil
This collection features four natural raw amethyst and quartz crystal specimens showcasing distinct geological crystal habits and coloration. Sourced from crystalline basalt geode deposits, these specimens display varied shades ranging from delicate lilac to deeper violet druzy terminated points resting on natural matrix bases.
Items Included:
Elongated quartz and light amethyst druzy cluster on dark basalt matrix with "Made in Brazil" label
Lavender botryoidal druzy cluster formation with subtle amber-toned quartz center
Upright amethyst cluster featuring distinct pyramidal crystal terminations on rough matrix
Sliced geode section displaying violet amethyst crystallization edged in white quartz
Condition:
All specimens are in natural rough state with naturally occurring crystalline terminations, surface texture, and matrix rock intact. Natural fractured edges, matrix variations, and mineral inclusions are present throughout as expected with raw earth stones. Original country of origin sticker remains affixed to one specimen.

description:
Raw Mineral & Rock Specimen Lot
Natural Geological Collection
5 Pieces
This assorted collection of five unpolished geological rock and mineral specimens features diverse textures, crystal formations, and mineral compositions. Ranging from crystalline aggregates to metamorphic and mineralized ore samples, this lot is well suited for educational study, earth science reference, or natural decorative display.
Items Included:
Large matrix plate featuring microcrystalline druzy pockets and earthy mineral tones
Coarse-grained crystalline rock specimen with quartz and feldspar matrix
Orange blocky cleavage specimen exhibiting distinct crystal planes
Elongated foliated metamorphic stone with visible mineral layering
Dense mineral ore rock with reddish-brown oxidation and dark metallic tones
Condition:
All five specimens are in natural, rough raw condition as collected. Surfaces exhibit natural fractures, irregular cleavage edges, natural sediment, and mineral veining. Free of artificial polishing or tumbling.

description:
Mixed Crystal, Mineral & Polished Stone Collection Approx. 5.9 lbs
Offered is an assorted collection of decorative crystal-like specimens, rocks, and polished stones with a combined weight of approximately 5.9 pounds.
The collection includes:
Several polished, pointed crystal-like specimens in assorted colors.
Multiple rough mineral and crystal-like clusters.
A long blue-and-white bladed specimen.
Assorted polished and tumbled stones in a variety of sizes, shapes, patterns, and colors.
Various rough, unpolished stones and mineral-like pieces.
Several shaped or carved decorative stones.
Colors include purple, pink, blue, green, white, clear, black, orange, brown, and multicolored patterns.
The collection contains pieces resembling quartz, amethyst, agate, jasper, and other mineral varieties. Individual stone identities, natural versus manufactured composition, and possible treatments have not been independently verified.
Condition:
Previously owned collection showing varying degrees of surface wear and natural-looking irregularities. Some specimens exhibit visible fractures, rough edges, inclusions, and uneven surfaces. Chips or damage may be present, particularly on pointed or clustered specimens. Individual stones have not been professionally inspected or graded.
Measurements and Weight:
Combined item weight: Approximately 5.9 pounds.
Individual specimen measurements are not available.
Testing:
Individual mineral compositions have not been verified through mineralogical testing.
Included Contents:
The mixed collection of stones and specimens shown in the photographs. No additional display stands, storage containers, or accessories are specified as included.
This item was donated and previously owned; its complete history is unknown. Photographs show the actual items and are part of the description. Shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). Orders will be shipped within
5 business days
(Monday-Friday) of payment. However, we make every effort to ship sooner. Shipping may be delayed in the event of unforeseen business closure for holidays, disasters, etc.
Our shipping software shops for the best shipping option for your order. The carrier that the item is listed with may not be the carrier with which the item(s) ship.
Combined Shipping:
Items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other, are safe to ship in one box, and we are contacted prior to payment. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.
Because of how our carriers charge for shipping, item weight is calculated based on the dimensional weight and not the actual weight of the item. This can potentially add to the shipping charge of combined orders if larger shipping materials are required.
Most of our Jewelry items are listed with a flat rate shipping fee. If you purchase more than one item, please send a Customer Service ticket through your Shopgoodwill.com account before paying so that we can remove the flat rate fee. After the flat rate fees are removed shipping cost will be calculated directly from the courier's site. Art, glass, musical instruments, prepackaged lots, heavy items, and other fragile items may not be eligible for combined shipping.
We do not ship orders to PO Boxes.
You will need a physical street address to receive your packages.
Signature Verification
: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.
Attention:
Goodwill Middle TN is not responsible for lost or stolen packages after delivery to the customer has been confirmed with tracking information. Contact FedEx or USPS for further information.

Polished Stone and Mineral Lot - 50 Pieces
Lapidary Gemstones, Agates, and Decorative Carvings
Natural and Polished Minerals
This expansive 50-piece lapidary collection features a diverse assortment of natural and polished stone specimens. The group includes decorative polished mineral eggs, a natural banded agate slice, cabochons, carved shapes including a heart and cube, and an array of smooth tumbled stones displaying rich color variations, banding, and crystal structures.
Items Included:
4 polished mineral eggs in green, yellow/orange, blue, and pink marble or stone
1 natural banded agate slice specimen
1 clear polished quartz palm stone
2 carved geometric shapes including a purple cube and a zebra-patterned heart
42 assorted tumbled stones, cabochons, and shaped lapidary specimens including agates, jaspers, carnelian, and sodalite
Condition:
Very good condition overall with average wear. Surfaces show smooth polish with occasional natural pitting, minor inclusions, and edge abrasions typical of natural mineral specimens.

This is a USED item donated to Goodwill of Eastern Kansas & Western Missouri.

Description:
Add a unique touch of natural beauty to your home decor with this quartz crystal flame and geode pair. The collection includes one carved rose quartz flame, featuring flowing natural patterns, soft pink coloring, and a sculptural form that stands out as a decorative accent. The stone's curved and polished surfaces create gentle reflections, making it a soothing focal point for any room. Alongside the flame, you'll find a matching pair of quartz geode halves, showcasing rough exteriors and sparkling crystal interiors with intricate formations and a grayish hue. These natural mineral pieces serve beautifully as desk ornaments, shelf displays, or as thoughtful gifts for collectors and enthusiasts of earth's wonders. Each item is in good condition, showing minor surface marks consistent with gentle handling. The pairing of the carved flame and natural geodes brings a harmonious blend of artistry and authenticity to any space

description:
Item Description:
Polished Agate Geode Bookends (Brazil), Turquoise, White, Green, Black Exterior
A pair of polished natural agate geode slabs, made into bookends; could also be used as separate desk sculptures or paperweights. Have a crusty black/purplish exterior with what appears to be natural but may be dyed turquoise upper layer "skin" border, with a white and clear feathered crystalline inner structure. One piece shows the center ball like glittery ball like formations of the inner geode, surrounded by a creamy off white color. On the reverse side, the surface is a more mottled and striped sage green and other teal and green hues more matte polished stone. The narrow face shows a blocky rectangular pair of images symmetrically opposed with an white geode crystal interior and a t shaped turquoise border. The variety of visual perspectives and colors/textures contained within this pair of polished rocks slabs thus makes for a very interesting and useful decor item.
Manufacturer/Markings:
One item has a white sticker "Made in Brazil"
Dimensions (LxWxH):
Each piece is approximately 4" x 2" x 3"
Color(s):
White, clear, turquoise, purplish black, cream color, green, teal, blue

In good condition with some natural damage/roughness as this is natural polished stone.

none

Approximately 3 lbs 8 oz.

description:
Art Glass Cullet Chunk
Cobalt Blue with Rainbow Iridescent Finish
Decorative Glass Specimen, 1.365 Pounds
Substantial decorative chunk of cobalt blue cullet slag glass displaying a vibrant iridescent carnival-style flash across fractured planes and smooth surfaces. Raw glass chunks like this were produced during the glassmaking process at heritage American glassworks, where excess furnace glass cooled into monolithic blocks before being fractured into decorative specimens prized for garden displays, lapidary projects, and paperweights.
Intense translucent cobalt blue glass body with rich color depth
Exterior exhibits strong rainbow iridescence in vivid hues of gold, magenta, and turquoise
Natural conchoidal fracturing showcasing glass cleavage, smooth waves, and raw crystalline textures

Condition:
Formed as a raw fractured glass chunk with natural sharp edges, conchoidal ridges, and cleavage faces inherent to slag glass. Clean surfaces with brilliant luster and no post-manufacture cloudiness or chemical damage.

Petrified Wood, Trochus Shell, Irridescent Ammonite, Agate Geodes, Opaline Glass
A natural history themed small collection in oranges, browns, whites, and iridescent tones, with a total weight of 9.9 oz. See list below for descriptions of each object:
1) a 3"x 2.5" x1" polished specimen of vibrant orange, red, white, brown petrified wood, with a barcode sticker on the bottom that reads "Petrified wood specimen" $16.99
2) a 2" x 2" spiral trochus shell, strawberry banded with red marks at the top section agatinst the white and nacre/iridescent sections.
3) a 1.5" x 1" sliced and polished spiral ammonite, beautifully defined in brown and grey sections; the reverse side is brown with iridescent nacre with an opal effect.
4) 2 small agatized and banded crystal geode halves, polished centers. One is 1" x 2" and the other is 2" x1.5". One is marbled black and brown and rust colors with white; one is lighter brown/yellow gold with darker brown rust colors banded with white.
5) A small polished piece of opaline glass, which appears a milky blue white, but throws vibrant orange shadows in the light, much like an actual opal.
6) a 1.5" x 1" flake of a bronze coppery metallic surface rock; the other side is rougher and more matte.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
